name: ULX3S

programming.details: An on-board FT231X provides USB-JTAG (500 kbit) and USB-serial; an on-board ESP32-WROOM-32 can also flash the ECP5 over JTAG, even wirelessly (emard/esp32ecp5).

description: A popular open-hardware ECP5 development board (LFE5U-12F/25F/45F/85F options) with an on-board ESP32-WROOM-32 that adds WiFi/Bluetooth and a standalone web-based JTAG flasher.
